snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Sacred Weapons: Launcher
snippet.description:
The Ruthless Steel Sci-Fi MMORPG, RF ONLINE NEXT

Meet the 'Sacred Weapon', a powerful combat unit capable of turning the tide of battle.

Today, we are introducing Accretia's Sacred Weapon, the Launcher.

The first of its prototype developed by Accretian research institutes, 
the Launcher is a powerful artillery weapon designed for efficient battlefield deployment.

Built with interchangeable body and weapon frames, the Launcher can be deployed for any tactical scenario.

🚀🚀🚀🚀

New-dimensional Mech MMORPG, Activate

A colossal mech battle unfolding in another dimension!
Step into humanity’s final story once left to imagination
